decision_rule: Corrected: the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, or tags a judgement or verdict as stated. Confirmed: the page (not only the quoted fragment) carries every additive clause; the fuller support is in note. Limiting parentheticals ('not mandatory overtime', 'not a certification', '2013 announcement') are not counted as additive.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (4 of 5 corrections). Sub-patterns for the sweep: (a) a job-posting qualification read as the plant's production process (Nucor Crawfordsville weld_processes); (b) planned or future facts written in the present tense on pre-production plants (Hapco 'more than one plant'); (c) one value combining two sources while citing only one (Hapco address: '577 Industrial Park' + I-240 location); (d) a detail not on the page ('steel' in Nucor products).
worst_errors: p-nucor-crawfordsville-in:weld_processes: 'MIG/flux-core' tagged stated, but the posting lists 'MIG flux core welding experience' only as a preferred qualification; the production process is not stated. score_process 20 is unsupported (65 -> 45, confidence 4 -> 3).

p-hapco-oklahoma-city-ok:parent_company: the value is a present-tense multi-plant claim ('Hapco has more than one plant') resting on a plant that is not built; the real parent (Dyson-Kissner-Moran Corporation, stated on inside.lighting) had no evidence row although plants.csv shows it. It supports score_scale 5 and confidence 3.
p-hapco-oklahoma-city-ok:address: compound value; 'OKC 577 Industrial Park' is not on the cited News9 page (it comes from okbusinessvoice.com).
score_problems: p-nucor-crawfordsville-in:score_process 20 rests on weld_processes, which this check corrected to unknown (a preferred qualification, not a stated production process). Under the run-log rule (only generic welding stated = 0): process 0, total 65 -> 45 (Medium, at the floor), confidence 4 -> 3.

p-hapco-oklahoma-city-ok:score_scale 5: 'multi-plant parent stated' cites parent_company, which stated a future second plant in the present tense (corrected). Hapco operates one plant today (Abingdon). The points could stand only if the parent Dyson-Kissner-Moran Corporation is evidenced as multi-plant; no row shows that. If removed: total 24 -> 19, confidence 3 -> 2.
p-hapco-oklahoma-city-ok: plants.csv parent_company 'Dyson-Kissner-Moran Corporation' had no evidence row (ground rule 1); the correction above supplies a stated quote.

p-chm-fort-worth-tx:score_material_part and p-structural-steel-products-fort-worth-tx:score_material_part: the reasoning text still says 'rubric level 12 applied as a fallback' while the value is 0 (the normalisation note is appended). Wording only; the points are correct.

Arithmetic checked for all 8 plants: totals equal the sum of components; tiers and confidence match the stated-support rule (Nucor 65/Medium/4, Union Metal 16/Low/2, Structures USA 23/Low/2, KW 28/Low/1, Cem-Tec 23/Low/2, CHM 28/Low/2, Hapco 24/Low/3, SSP 21/Low/2), before the changes above.

p-nucor-crawfordsville-in:score_labor 12: one Fitter Welder posting counted; the two open Automation Operator (robotic weld-cell) postings need 6 months welding experience but were not counted as 'several at once'. Coordinator's stated judgement; noted, not flagged as an error.
opening_line_problems: p-structures-usa-elizabethtown-ky: 'a June 15, 2026 PennDOT letter recommends listing it' is wrong. The letter is on Structures USA's own letterhead, addressed to PennDOT and signed by a Manager of Engineering, and refers to PennDOT in the third person. Suggested: '... and in a June 15, 2026 letter to PennDOT its engineering manager recommends listing it as an approved fabricator for mast arms, strain poles and pedestal poles.'

p-hapco-oklahoma-city-ok: 'operations expected in late 2027' and 'welding among the 80-plus new jobs' have no stated evidence row; the rows the line cites (weld_processes, headcount) are inferred. The facts are on stated pages (inside.lighting: 'operations expected to begin in late 2027'; okbusinessvoice.com: 'positions ... including production, welding, ...'), so stated rows should be added or the clauses dropped.

p-kw-industries-sugar-land-tx: the line rests only on company-level claims (c-kw-industries:production_type); the plant-level equivalents are inferred. It is worded as a company statement ('KW Industries says its facilities...'), so it is accurate, but it is not a plant-level stated claim.

p-nucor-crawfordsville-in: 'is investing $105 million' drops the release's 'pending receipt of regulatory and other approvals'; 'already runs robotic weld cells' is supported by the Automation Operator duty line ('Load, operate, and maintain robotic plasma and weld cells', welder_postings row), not by the existing_robots rows the line cites (a plan and a job title). Minor.
None of the 8 opening lines asserts a current Path deployment.

Structures USA: 2024 Kentucky SOS filing and June 2026 letter at 333 Peterson Dr. KW Sugar Land: AISC lists both Sugar Land and East Bernard. Cem-Tec, CHM, SSP: live sites or 2026 lists at the recorded addresses.
